headline: Half-Life - Valve's first game
title: Half-Life 1998 | Valve Debut Facts | Classic Games
video_script: Half-Life was the first game from Valve. It was released in nineteen ninety eight for Windows and published by Sierra. You play Gordon Freeman, a scientist trying to escape the Black Mesa Research Facility after an experiment goes wrong. By two thousand eight, it had sold more than nine million copies. Did you play Half-Life? Comment below!
description: Half-Life was Valve's first game, released in 1998 for Windows and published by Sierra, and it had sold more than nine million copies by 2008.
